ResearchProjectDef.label: digging down
ResearchProjectDef.description: Basic shoring and stair-cutting to open the first basement beneath your colony — one full level of solid rock the same size as the map above.

ResearchProjectDef.label: deep excavation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Surveying and reinforcement techniques for carving stable living space below the first basement — opening B2 and every level deeper.

ResearchProjectDef.label: elevators
ResearchProjectDef.description: Powered elevator cars for moving colonists between levels in a compact shaft - faster and tidier than a cut stairwell, at the cost of a power hookup.

ResearchProjectDef.label: forced ventilation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Powered fans and impellers for moving air where it will not move itself: one-way exhaust fans that pull smoke out of a room, and updraft filters that drive fumes up an excavated shaft like a chimney stack.

ResearchProjectDef.label: deep life support
ResearchProjectDef.description: Powered oxygen pumps for sealed rooms, CO₂ pumps that scrub exhaled waste from the air, and shaft gas exchangers that actively drive breathable air up a stairwell while pulling carbon dioxide down — the plumbing deep colonies need once colonists start living below the surface.

ResearchProjectDef.label: deep gas extraction
ResearchProjectDef.description: Wellheads and pressure canisters for capping the gas vents found in deep rock - turning a toxic, explosive seep into generator fuel that burns with no smoke at all.

ResearchProjectDef.label: shaft power
ResearchProjectDef.description: Armored power junctions that carry electricity up and down an excavated shaft, letting a surface grid feed the levels below (and the reverse).

ResearchProjectDef.label: fluid shafts
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build shaft fluid junctions that meter water, coolant, heating, and gas between levels without merging pipe networks across maps. Only junction types for your loaded pipe mods appear in the architect menu.
